transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time on short notice. As you know, we've received a credible report that our authorized distributor routed some medical-device orders through an unfamiliar sub-distributor in a restricted market. No shipment suspension, regulatory disclosure, contractual notice, or termination decision has been issued yet. Before I approve any written response package, I need to walk through the situation with each of you under our incident-response protocol. Let's go around the table: sanctions, contracts, and client-operations leads — please bring me up to speed on what you're seeing on your end.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share critical findings before we go any further. This morning I completed transaction screening and confirmed that two shipments went to an Iran-linked reseller not covered by any applicable OFAC general license. My report requires immediate suspension of distributor shipments and a voluntary OFAC disclosure filed within exactly 10 days. I have not circulated the report yet, but given where we are in this conversation, I need everyone to understand the urgency and the mandatory steps we're facing.
